machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16 GiB, driver 610.88
machine.cpu: Intel Core i9-14900KF (8 P + 16 E, 32 threads), no AVX-512 (AVX-2 expert kernels)

method.prompts: per measured request a different prompt of the same token count: paragraphs shuffled from repo prose (docs/**/*.md, src/**/*.cpp, README.md, AGENTS.md) by a tag-seeded LCG, tokenised with the pack's tokenizer
method.warmup: one discarded request per case before the measured reps
method.prefill_tok_s: prompt_read * 1000 / prompt_ms (prompt_read == prompt tokens; the conversation cache never serves a measured rep)
method.decode_tok_s: generated / decode_ms from the engine's DONE line
method.order: interleaved A/B, old engine arms repeated last as a noise control
